text: See bd-01KZXEVFW3X074685EXWJZNP2D. Epic 4 is claimed while its declared blocker Epic 0A is open - mote ready confirms Epic 4 is not ready. The ordering matters substantively: the acceptance criterion "execution receipt records the actual lowering" is currently unfalsifiable, because geometry(), evaluate_geometry() and .run_geometry_compiler accept no normalizer/transform/reducer, .compiler_plan_id carries them as defaults only, and the receipt at compiler.R:690-699 hardcodes the same values. One possible plan means no test can distinguish "reads the plan" from "constant that happens to match". The only things that can make lowering vary are the edge-operation exports Epic 0A must wire up or delete. Settle 0A before freezing the plan/receipt schema.
